question: Which of the following players scored the first century in a cricket test match for India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lala Amarnath.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lala Amarnath:**

 
 
• In Indian cricket, Lala Amarnath Bhardwaj, who lived from 11 September 1911 to 5 August 2000, is revered as the father figure.
 
• **During England's 1933 tour of India, he achieved the first-ever century for India in Test Cricket. **
 
• He led India in their maiden Test series victory over Pakistan in 1952 and was the country's first cricket captain after independence.
 
• In 1991, the Indian government bestowed upon him the civilian honor of **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• The highest accolade given by the BCCI to a former player, the C. K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement
